items.title: Classify main dirty baseline and doc assets
items.context: Use git status/diff to group tracked modifications, deletions, and untracked docs. Do not touch .omx and do not revert anything before classification.
items.userSees: Terminal report includes: "B-d925 classification: baseline artifacts=<n>, docs=<n>, story metadata=<n>, recommended action=<commit|restore|defer>".

happy.desc: Classification report groups all current main dirty paths into baseline artifacts, docs, story metadata, and untracked docs.

edge.desc: Deleted tracked baseline artifacts are classified separately from modified suite reports and untracked docs.

adversarial.desc: No .omx path is read or used while classifying dirty assets.

items.title: Run two-host audit on the cleanup decision
items.context: Claude CLI and Codex CLI should independently review whether dirty assets should be committed, restored, or deferred. Only real correctness issues may drive changes.
items.userSees: Two independent host audit summaries from Claude CLI and Codex CLI agree on whether each dirty asset group should be committed, restored, or deferred.

items.title: Apply the minimal reconciliation that unblocks B-9d6c DONE
items.context: Make main clean by committing valid assets or restoring confirmed stale/scratch changes, then verify B-9d6c can advance to DONE.
items.userSees: The main worktree is clean, B-9d6c can advance to DONE, and any retained cleanup commit is clearly separate from the B-9d6c implementation commit.
